approval_basis: Reviewed outside the release automation; Gate identity resolved once here through the release module's own gate builder rather than by manual re-hashing. (1) dtype ownership is genuinely single: LOAD_DTYPE_MISMATCH now occurs only in _verify_access_maps and takes its source from AccessMap.buffer instead of Operation.reads[0], the synonymous ACCESS_INDEXED_RESULT_DTYPE is gone from the tree, the residual LOAD branch in _verify_operation_shape carries only the OP_LOAD_SOURCE space check, and both the direct and the runtime-indexed falsifiers assert equality on the whole set of DTYPE findings, so a re-introduced duplicate fails a test. (2) The reduce fp32 rule is not over-narrow: emit_triton is the only admitted backend with a REDUCE body emitter, emit_cutedsl has none and the third route is a fixed checked asset, and both Triton templates take the source through .to(tl.float32) with an fp32 loop identity in all of identity, accumulate and once. The rule therefore states the union of current backend capability; it becomes over-narrow only if a future backend gains a non-fp32 REDUCE emitter, at which point emit_triton.preflight is the seam that already exists for it. (3) kda-weighted-combine-b8-smoke composes only existing primitives: a mechanical comparison against HEAD shows zero enum members added or removed, and no vocabulary entry contains combine, scatter, cast, moe, gather or route. It is the arithmetic body of KDA MoE v1's non-fused weighted combine -- indexed gather of expert rows, route-weight scaling along the route axis, fp32 sum over that axis, one narrowed bf16 store -- and ADR 0034 names what it excludes, including route selection, dispatch, both grouped GEMMs, fused atomic scatter and the combine kernel's persistent-workspace reset side effect. It makes no complete KDA version expressible and authorizes no performance claim. (4) The expectation diff is one added positive case expecting only RESIDENCY_BOUND, plus one additional ELEMENTWISE_RESULT_DTYPE finding on the existing flash-kmeans dtype falsifier that was already failing for a declared dtype drift; no case was removed and no accepted or lowering_eligible disposition flipped anywhere. Each of the five new dtype codes has a minimal failing test, and the positive schedule asserts an exact finding set. (5) The Compiler's own check_corpus recomputed the Gate at 33 of 33 with no mismatched case, and the Gate report declares 49 sources. The 88 currently failing suite items were classified line by line with none outside the pending-release class: the frozen v25 lock refusing the current manifest, and the stale approval this file replaces. Not covered by this approval: ADR 0034 remains proposed and its fifth acceptance item, a brokered B200 correctness run against an independent gather-weight-sum oracle, has not been observed; this approves the compiler-side expressibility slice only.
